transactions.desc: The Padres added Workman to the 26-man active roster ahead of Tuesday's game against the Diamondbacks.
The Cubs released Blach on Saturday.
Wantz elected free agency Monday.
The Cubs designated Little for assignment Monday.
The Padres optioned Duran to Triple-A El Paso on Tuesday.
The Padres optioned Sears to Triple-A El Paso on Tuesday.
The Tigers recalled Diaz from Triple-A Toledo on Tuesday, Evan Woodbery of MLive.com reports.
The Mets outrighted Melendez to Triple-A Syracuse on Tuesday.
The Mets outrighted Herget to Triple-A Syracuse on Tuesday.
The Red Sox released Kahnle on Tuesday, Chris Cotillo of MassLive.com reports.
The Cubs optioned Alcantara to Triple-A Iowa on Tuesday.
The Cubs designated Woodford for assignment Tuesday, Jared Wyllys of AllCHGO.com reports.
The Rockies selected Mushinski from Triple-A Albuquerque on Tuesday.
The Rays optioned Piper to Double-A Montgomery on Tuesday, though he'll remain with the big-league club through Wednesday's series finale in Colorado as a member of the taxi squad.
Donovan (groin) was activated from the 10-day injured list Tuesday and is starting at third base versus the Tigers, Daniel Kramer of MLB.com reports.
The Mariners designated Fairchild for assignment Tuesday.
The Rays optioned Grove to Triple-A Durham on Tuesday.
The Dodgers designated Robinson for assignment Tuesday.
The Rays designated Solesky for assignment Monday.
The Dodgers selected Rortvedt's contract from Triple-A Oklahoma City on Tuesday.
The Marlins recalled Ramirez from Triple-A Jacksonville on Tuesday.
The Dodgers optioned Alfonzo to Triple-A Oklahoma City on Tuesday.
The Royals claimed Thomas off waivers from the Athletics on Tuesday and optioned him to Triple-A Omaha.
The Twins optioned Rojas to Triple-A St. Paul on Tuesday.
The Phillies optioned Backhus to Triple-A Lehigh Valley on Tuesday, Todd Zolecki of MLB.com reports.
The Nationals selected Pinckney's contract from Triple-A Rochester on Tuesday, Danielle Allentuck of The Washington Post reports.
The Pirates optioned Murdock to Triple-A Indianapolis on Tuesday.
The Red Sox optioned Gonzalez to Triple-A Worcester on Tuesday, Chris Henrique of BostonSportsJournal.com reports
The Phillies optioned Rincones to Triple-A Lehigh Valley on Tuesday, Todd Zolecki of MLB.com reports.
The Nationals acquired Glassey from the Orioles on Monday in exchange for outfielder Christian Franklin, Andy Kostka of TheBanner.com reports.
